remarks: *Elegant Colonial Home with In-Law Suite* Welcome to 30 Nichols Ave, a stunning four-bedroom, three-bathroom colonial home nestled in a desirable Stamford neighborhood. This beautifully maintained single-family residence boasts an impressive layout, perfect for families, multi-generational living, or those seeking a smart investment opportunity. The main level features a bright and airy living space, ideal for relaxing and entertaining. The heart of the home is the kitchen, equipped with ample counter space and cabinetry. Four spacious bedrooms, including a serene master suite, provide plenty of room for rest and relaxation. The lower level features a fully functional in-law apartment, perfect for extended family members, au pairs, or generating rental income. This separate living space offers a comfortable retreat with its own amenities. This property offers a unique blend of space, functionality, and convenience. A MUST SEE !!!
